events.title: The Lunar Wardens demo is moving to October 19
events.summary: Hello Wardens,We planned to release the Lunar Wardens demo tomorrow. That is not going to happen, and we want to tell you why.Every demo on Steam has to pass a review before it can go live. Ours is still in that review, and we cannot release it until it is approved. So we are moving the demo to a date we can keep:The Lunar Wardens demo will be out on October 19.Nothing about the demo itself has changed.
